name: Kolibri 1.1 model card
notes: Fetched 2026-11-25. Aleph Alpha Kolibri 1.1 card. Repo created 2026-11-20, card prints Release Date '23rd of November 2026'. Licence apache-2.0. Card nameplate: 75B (75,128,393,984) total and 3.44B (3,439,874,304) active per token; HF safetensors.total is 75,112,665,344, a 15.7M gap on the nameplate that the card does not explain (probably the unsharded lm_head). Evaluation section states all models run through Aleph Alpha's own eval-framework with temperature 0.6, top_p 0.6, max_tokens 1024 (Gemma 4 26B-A4B at its own recommended 1.0/0.95), long-context extension on where applicable. Two benchmark tables are printed: a post-training table (12 model columns) and a base-model capability table. Cost figures come from vLLM 0.33 on one 8xB200 node at 8-bit weights.
